zh.title: F-16V blk70首批2架降落臺東志航基地
zh.summary: F-16V blk70首批2架降落臺東志航基地；臺美共同點交
body: 空軍對美採購66架全新F-16V（blk70）戰機，首批2架（編號6727、6728）今天中午12時左右依序飛抵並降落臺東志航基地，滑行至機堡後將與美方共同點交。
空軍表示，首批2架（編號6727、6728）美東時間8月17日自美國德州起飛後降落夏威夷，歷經近1個半月的檢整，昨天自夏威夷飛往關島，並歷經多次空中加油，今天上午8時許自關島起飛，於中午12時許依序飛抵臺灣。
軍方說明，飛返臺灣的F-16V（blk70）由美方人員駕駛，且目前仍屬美方財產，因此戰機落地並滑行至機堡後，空軍將與美方進行點交。

en.title: First two F-16V Block 70 jets land at Taiwan's Chihhang Air Base
en.summary: First two F-16V Block 70 jets land at Chihhang Air Base; joint handover with US
body: The first two of 66 new F-16V (Block 70) fighter jets purchased by the Air Force landed at Chihhang Air Base in Taitung around noon today, and will undergo a joint handover with the US side after taxiing to the hangar.

The Air Force said the first two aircraft, numbered 6727 and 6728, took off from Texas on August 17 Eastern Time, landed in Hawaii, and after nearly a month and a half of maintenance, flew from Hawaii to Guam yesterday. After multiple in-flight refueling, they departed Guam this morning around 8 a.m. and arrived in Taiwan at around noon.
The military stated that the F-16V (Block 70) aircraft were flown by US personnel and remain US property, so the Air Force will conduct a handover with the US side after landing and taxiing.

zh.title: 菲律賓航空10月25日起復飛馬尼拉－塞班直飛航線
zh.summary: 菲律賓航空；10月25日復飛馬尼拉至塞班航線
body: 菲律賓航空（Philippine Airlines）宣佈，自2026年10月25日起恢復馬尼拉與北馬利安納羣島塞班之間的直飛航班服務。
該航線連接馬尼拉尼諾伊·艾奎諾國際機場（MNL）與塞班國際機場（SPN），並定位為結合菲律賓與塞班的多目的地度假旅遊路線。
菲律賓航空表示，該服務將強化其亞洲與太平洋地區的航網，並支援菲律賓、北馬利安納羣島與亞洲主要市場之間的旅遊及商業聯繫。

en.title: Philippine Airlines to restore nonstop Manila-Saipan flights from Oct 25, 2026
en.summary: Philippine Airlines; nonstop flights resume Oct 25, 2026
body: Philippine Airlines (PAL) has announced it will restore nonstop service between Manila and Saipan, the largest island of the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands, starting October 25, 2026.

The route will connect Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL) in Manila with Saipan International Airport (SPN). It is positioned as a leisure link for multi-destination holidays combining the Philippines with Saipan.

PAL said it is also targeting connecting traffic through its Manila hub, and that the service strengthens its network across Asia and the Pacific while supporting tourism and commercial ties between the Philippines, the Northern Mariana Islands and key Asian markets.
